_note: Delete semantics here are irreplaceable - soft vs hard, what cascades, what survives. Reproduce exactly.

get_signup_field_value._INCONSISTENCY: Parameter is `signup_field_value_id`, NOT `id`. Every other get_* uses `id`. Reproduce exactly for parity (ADR-006).

_batch_envelope.cap: BATCH_MAX_ITEMS (value not disclosed in the tool schema)
_batch_envelope.responses: 200 all deleted | 207 any failed | 400 empty envelope or over cap
_batch_envelope.duplicates: first-wins on id; later occurrences pre-marked duplicate_in_batch pointing at /data/{i}/id, without reaching the service
_batch_envelope.per_item_failure: already-deleted / wrong-org / malformed ids surface as per-item not_found, never a document-level error

delete_quizzes.cascade: SOFT-deletes the quiz's OWN questions and their answers; HARD-removes its question-bank ASSIGNMENTS; then SOFT-deletes the quiz. Shared question banks and their bank-owned questions/answers are UNTOUCHED - a quiz only owns questions where question.quiz == quiz.

delete_questions.cascade: SOFT-deletes the question's answers, then the question. Parent quiz / bank and its other questions untouched. A question is homed under a quiz XOR a bank, which is why the scope is OR.

delete_question_banks.cascade: SOFT-deletes the bank's questions and their answers; HARD-removes every QuestionBankAssignment referencing the bank (unbinding any quizzes that used it); then SOFT-deletes the bank. Quizzes that referenced it stay ALIVE - only their assignment rows go.

delete_groups.cascade: HARD delete - StudentGroup is NOT a SoftDeletionModel. All FK-back relations cascade at the database: memberships, visibility overrides, other link tables. Per-row .delete() fires pre_delete/post_delete, preserving the Salesforce sync receiver and workflow/analytics cleanup hooks.

delete_web_package.cascade: Soft-delete. Returns 409 when a lesson in a LIVE course still references the package - deleting it would leave that lesson with no content. Otherwise 204.
delete_web_package._why_not_batch: The conflict outcome has no natural home in a per-row batch result; batch-responses.md warns against letting a ConflictError fall through the document-level path mid-batch. Matches DELETE /v2/students/{id}.

delete_published_course.cascade: A soft unpublish, matching v1 DELETE behaviour.
